caption:
More homes entered the market than went under contract in a new three-county Austin-area snapshot.

Cain Realty Group’s October 12 weekly report lists:

• Travis County: 358 new listings; 177 new contracts
• Williamson County: 193 new listings; 135 new contracts
• Hays County: 75 new listings; 52 new contracts

Combined: 626 new listings and 364 new contracts. The report also records 276 closed sales across the three counties.

Why it matters locally: Buyers have fresh options to review, while sellers should keep an eye on competing listings in their own neighborhood and price range.

These counts describe different weekly activity groups. They are not the same homes moving through a single funnel, and subtracting contracts from listings does not measure the change in active inventory. Closed sales usually reflect contracts signed earlier.

One weekly snapshot does not establish a sustained trend or classify the entire Austin metro as a buyer’s or seller’s market. This report covers Travis, Williamson and Hays counties, rather than the complete Austin MSA.

Source: Cain Realty Group, October 12, 2026
